title: Book Two · Chapter 84: Mum Takes the Window Seat
story:
The winter holiday begins. Mum has one whole day for a visit to her friend. Her customers have collected their finished clothes. Her next job starts tomorrow.

Ronan sees her put on the blue skirt. She checks the weather at the window. Then she takes her coat.

“Can we come?” he asks.

“Today I am going alone.”

“Why?”

“We want a long talk.”

Dad brings her bag from the chair. Mum takes her bag and checks inside. She puts a small food packet on top.

“For us?” Ronan asks.

“For my friend.”

“What do we eat?”

Dad looks around the kitchen. “We may find something.”

Mum smiles, but she does not start making another packet. “I will be back before supper,” she says. Then she leaves through the green door.

Dad and Ronan stand in the kitchen. There are vegetables, rice and two eggs. Ronan takes out three bowls, then puts one back.

“Two for lunch.”

Dad washes the rice. Ronan cleans the vegetables in the basin. A long leaf breaks in his hand. He holds up both halves.

“Still a vegetable,” Dad says.

They make a simple meal. Dad handles the hot pan. Ronan puts the cooked food on the table. Dad is about to sit down. Then Ronan remembers the spoons.

At first, the kitchen seems very quiet. Then Dad tells a story about a customer with a chair too wide for his doorway. He does not name the customer. “How did the chair come out of the house?” Ronan asks.

“Through a wider back door.”

“Did you try the front?”

Dad covers his face for a moment. Ronan laughs loudly. The cat looks in from the yard.

After lunch, they wash the bowls. Dad rests, and Ronan reads his own book near the window. He keeps one finger under the line and takes his time with the page. Later, they walk to the square for a short time. They take no work and no shopping list.

Mum returns before supper. She looks pleased and a little cold. Ronan brings her a cup of warm water. She sits in the window seat. She keeps her coat on.

“Good talk?” Dad asks.

“Very good.”

Ronan wants the whole story. Mum gives them a few parts, then holds her cup with both hands. Dad begins supper. Ronan goes to get the third bowl. This time, all three bowls stay on the table. Mum's is beside the warmest place.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

seat＝座位；visit＝拜访；packet＝小包。

## 理解问题

1. Mum为什么独自出门？
2. 父子在家怎样照顾自己的生活？

## 读句子

**Dad / washes / the rice.** Dad／淘洗／大米。
